candidate_description: Mitra full-parameter50 with paired3072support/256query episodes; version/run identifiers intentionally unassigned
recommendation: Reasonable single-mechanism hypothesis for one bounded synthetic resource gate; feasibility and accuracy remain unverified. Do not start CV from this proposal.

hypothesis.mechanism: Training support grows1024→3072 while inference remains4636/8693. This narrows, but does not eliminate, support-context mismatch. More support changes attention/quantile statistics and available label evidence for the same query examples.
hypothesis.not_evidence_of_effect: The online improvement of v81 does not prove context mismatch caused its remaining errors or that longer episodes improve accuracy.
alternative_outcomes: Extra context could improve inference transfer.
More redundant support or different quantile/attention statistics could worsen optimization/generalization.
Fixed50 updates still consume the same256 query targets per update; support expansion is not more labeled query supervision.
Longer context can exceed memory/time even though parameter/AdamW bytes are unchanged.
hypothesis.adaptive_development_disclosure: These development rows/folds, earlier results and the online v81 outcome informed this proposal. This is adaptive model improvement, not an independent confirmatory test.
